scope: CPU assembly and local ASGI scheduling; simulated generation and agent cleanup

method.transport: in-process HTTPX ASGI; real shard.health and finalize, simulated generation/process cleanup
method.source_isolation: fresh worker per run, checkout cwd and unique PYTHONPATH; loaded production module paths and SHA256 verified
method.quantile: nearest-rank ceil(0.99*N); one sample per absolute scheduled probe tick
method.short_latency: planned arrival to HTTP response, including scheduler/admission queue time
method.export_latency: batch planned arrival to HTTP response, including admission and worker queue time
method.throughput: completed exports / maximum recorded export response latency; coordinator resume time excluded
method.window: fixed short-arrival schedule and fixed export batch both completed, plus fixed drain
method.rss: parent samples worker VmRSS every 10ms during measurement; ru_maxrss also reported
method.warmup: unreported full-workload worker runs; each measured worker also finalizes one same-size session and warms health
method.content: post-measurement digest of training fields, excluding wall-clock trace metadata
method.profiling: optional synchronous main-thread production assembly after warmup and before timing; profile trials are diagnostic-only

repetitions.variant_order: iteration offset modulo 2, including discarded warmup

optimized.post_measurement_change: pre-commit wrapped docstrings only; executable AST unchanged. Measured hashes are retained above; submitted hashes identify the final files.

normalization: Deduplicate identical workload, source manifests and content digests; omit process IDs and absolute checkout paths. Per-run statistics and summaries retain the original precision.

post_measurement_formatting.rerun_status: Additional repeat interrupted at user request; only the previously completed full matrix is reported.
